content: function  Dem_SetEventStatus  [SWS_CP_DIAG_00001]   Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventStatus(Dem_EventIdType EventId, Dem_EventStatusType EventStatus); Service to report the status of a diagnostic event by SW-Cs or BSW modules. Triggers internal fault debounce algorithms (counter-based or timer-based) before transitioning qualification states.
